outcome: REJECTED BY GOOGLE ADS BEFORE ANY WRITE
atomicity: partial_failure=false, so the batch was all-or-nothing. NOTHING was changed.

blocker.meaning: Google Ads allows at most 3 ENABLED responsive search ads per ad group. Paused RSAs do not count: each of the three ad groups reports existing_count=2 while holding 4 non-removed RSAs (2 ENABLED originals + 2 PAUSED replacements). Enabling both replacements would make 4 enabled, which exceeds the limit.
validated_facts: Enabling all six at once: REJECTED, 3 errors (operations 1, 3, 5 - the second ad in each group).
Enabling ONE replacement per ad group: VALIDATES OK.
Pausing the 6 originals and enabling the 6 replacements in one atomic request: VALIDATES OK.
blocker.why_the_original_sequence_was_wrong: The enablement package 80868F985D33B756 assumed the replacements could be enabled first and the originals paused later, to guarantee no service interruption. The 3-enabled-RSA limit makes that impossible for 2 new + 2 old. The premise was also unnecessary: the six originals are DISAPPROVED and therefore cannot serve, so pausing them causes NO service interruption at all.
